[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]SMAPI - and requirements[/b]
[/list] ﻿ Make sure SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) and CP (Content Patcher)/AT (Alternative Textures) are downloaded and up to date!

﻿[b]2. Vampiric Animals[/b]
﻿ Install this mod!

[b]﻿3. Mod Folder[/b]
﻿ Unzip Vampiric Animals and place it into your mods folder! (It can be in a subfolder if you like to keep things organized.)

[b][color=#980000]---------------------------------------[/color][/b]

[b]Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Content Patcher Version
[/list] ﻿ - Includes animal overrides [i]and[/i] associated item overrides 
﻿ ﻿- [b]Can[/b] be used with other AT animal mods

[list]
[*][b]Alternative Textures Version[/b]
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- Includes animal overrides, but [b]not[/b] associated item overrides (in case you want to use other animal textures at the same time)
